fiscaleRust.title: Fiscale Rust
fiscaleRust.subtitle: Estimate your tax reserve using rates for the selected year and assumptions for your situation.
fiscaleRust.subtitleVpb: Estimate your company's VAT and profit tax reserve. Salary and dividends need a separate calculation.
fiscaleRust.estimateHint: A tool to help you set money aside. This calculation does not determine your tax bill.
fiscaleRust.periodHint: Enter revenue, costs and VAT for the same period. For a month or quarter, we project profit over a full year. No specific month or quarter is selected automatically.
fiscaleRust.unsupportedYear: Saldova does not yet have verified rates for {currentYear}. This calculation uses tax year {year}; do not treat these as rates for {currentYear}.
fiscaleRust.dropHint: Preview incoming transactions and choose which belong to your revenue.
fiscaleRust.localFileHint: Your file stays in this browser and is not saved. Maximum 2 MB and 10,000 rows.
fiscaleRust.manualHint: Include business revenue only. Loans, transfers between your accounts and personal deposits are not revenue.
fiscaleRust.manualError: Enter an amount from 0 to {max}, with no more than two decimal places.
fiscaleRust.costsHint: Exclude recoverable VAT from costs. VAT you cannot reclaim belongs in your costs. Also account for deduction limits and depreciation.
fiscaleRust.costsHintKor: Under KOR, you cannot deduct input VAT. Include this non-recoverable VAT in your business costs.
fiscaleRust.inputVatHint: Enter the VAT you are entitled to reclaim for this period. It is not inferred from your costs or your sales VAT rate.
fiscaleRust.korActive: KOR is enabled in your invoice settings: no VAT on this revenue and no deduction of input VAT.
fiscaleRust.vatTimingHint: A bank receipt does not automatically belong in the same VAT return period. Under the invoice system, the invoice date usually determines the period; under cash accounting, receipt does. Check which revenue and input VAT belong in this period.
fiscaleRust.csvSelectionHint: No transactions are selected when the file opens. Choose only revenue from the selected period. Exclude loans, transfers and personal deposits. Selected amounts are used only after you apply them.
fiscaleRust.csvSkipped: {count} invalid or unrecognised rows were skipped. Check your source file.
fiscaleRust.csvMissingDates: Some incoming transactions have no date. Check that they belong to the selected year and intended period.
fiscaleRust.csvOutsideYear: {count} transactions are outside {year} and cannot be selected.
fiscaleRust.csvEmpty: No usable incoming EUR transactions found. Check the columns, dates and currency, or enter revenue manually.
fiscaleRust.csvError: This CSV could not be processed. Check its contents and use a maximum of 2 MB and 10,000 rows.
fiscaleRust.csvSelectionError: Select revenue from the chosen year, with a total no greater than {max}.
fiscaleRust.ibHint: 30% is only a starting value, not your personal tax rate or a guarantee of a sufficient reserve. Entrepreneur deductions, the SME profit exemption, tax credits and other income are not included. Match your percentage to your expected tax bill. For a partnership (vof), income tax and Zvw must be calculated per partner; this calculator does not allocate profit or personal annual limits across multiple partners.
fiscaleRust.safetyLabel: Extra margin on the tax reserve
fiscaleRust.safetyHint: This margin is added to VAT, profit tax and any Zvw contribution. It starts at 10%; even with a margin, the result remains an estimate.
fiscaleRust.advancedTitle: Mixed VAT and your annual profit projection
fiscaleRust.customVatLabel: I know the actual VAT included in my revenue
fiscaleRust.outputVatHint: Use this for mixed VAT rates or a known VAT total. It replaces the single-rate calculation and cannot exceed the revenue entered.
fiscaleRust.annualProfitLabel: Expected profit for the whole year (optional)
fiscaleRust.annualProfitHint: Expected annual profit after business costs. This replaces the multiplication of your period profit. Entrepreneur deductions, exemptions, credits and prior losses are not applied automatically. You may enter a negative loss.
fiscaleRust.amountError: Check ‘{field}’. Use no more than two decimal places and an amount up to {max}. Only annual profit may be negative; output VAT cannot exceed revenue.
fiscaleRust.calculationError: These inputs could not be calculated. Check the amounts and use no more than two decimal places.
fiscaleRust.emptyState: Enter revenue and choose Calculate, or review and apply a selection from your bank CSV.
fiscaleRust.bufferSub: Based on {amount} revenue in the selected period, including your chosen extra margin.
fiscaleRust.freeHint: This is not a bank balance or money available to spend. Outstanding invoices, debts, investments, personal withdrawals and tax already paid are not included.
fiscaleRust.splitTitle: What your estimated reserve consists of

btw.label: VAT reserve
btw.sub: Output VAT less actual deductible input VAT.

ib.label: Income tax reserve
ib.sub: Based on your percentage and projected annual profit.

zvw.label: Zvw reserve
zvw.sub: Annual contribution on the profit base, allocated to this period.

vpb.label: Corporate tax reserve
vpb.sub: Annual bands applied to projected profit, allocated to this period.

safety.label: Extra margin
safety.sub: Additional reserve on top of the calculated tax buffer.

free.label: Profit remaining after reserves
free.sub: Profit after the profit tax reserve, any Zvw and extra margin. Not a cash or bank balance.

fiscaleRust.vpbHint: {year} rates: {low} up to {threshold} annual profit and {high} above that. The annual reserve is allocated to the selected period.
fiscaleRust.dgaHint: Customary director salary, payroll taxes and taxes on dividends are not calculated. Include business salary costs in your profit projection and have your personal tax assessed separately.
fiscaleRust.legalFormNote: Change your legal form under Settings → Company details.
fiscaleRust.shortfall: The entered costs and reserves exceed revenue by {amount}. This scenario leaves no profit after reserves; check your funding and annual projection.
fiscaleRust.vatRefund: Input VAT exceeds output VAT by {amount}. This potential VAT credit is shown separately and does not count as available money.
fiscaleRust.korExceeded: The revenue entered for this period already exceeds the annual KOR threshold of {threshold}. We therefore do not show a KOR-based reserve: VAT around the threshold crossing cannot be determined from one total. Review your transactions and KOR setting with your accountant before recalculating.
fiscaleRust.korProjected: At the same revenue in each period, annual revenue would exceed the KOR threshold of {threshold}. This is a projection, not a confirmed breach. Track your actual annual revenue.
fiscaleRust.projectionHint: Annual projected profit equals period profit × {count}. Annual rates, caps and bands are applied to that projection first; the annual reserve is then divided by {count}. Uneven revenue may produce a different annual result.
fiscaleRust.projectionOverrideHint: Your own annual profit projection replaces the automatic estimate. We use it to calculate the annual reserve and divide that by {count}. This spreads the reserve evenly across the year and does not reconcile tax already paid.
fiscaleRust.zvwExplanation: Zvw {year}: {rate} on contribution income up to {max} per year, then divided across {count} period(s). Your projected profit is used as a simplified contribution base. Zvw already charged through wages or benefits is not included.
fiscaleRust.calculationLimits: Tax deductions, exemptions, tax credits, prior losses and other income are not applied automatically. Negative profit remains visible; a potential VAT refund does not fund the reserve.
fiscaleRust.zvwSource: Dutch Tax Administration: Zvw rates and contribution cap
fiscaleRust.vpbSource: Dutch Tax Administration: corporate tax rates
fiscaleRust.inputVatSource: Dutch Tax Administration: deductible input VAT
fiscaleRust.disclaimer: This reserve estimate is not a tax return or assessment. Review your annual projection, tax position and percentages with your accountant. Information on this page is not saved.

changePlan.q: Can I change my subscription mid-term?

about.title: Our mission: administrative calm for every entrepreneur.
about.intro: For too many entrepreneurs, admin is too complex, too slow and too expensive. Saldova turns that around: one sleek, lightning-fast tool that handles your admin in minutes — so you spend your time on your business, not your bookkeeping.

speed.title: Speed above all
speed.desc: No sluggish software or endless loading times. Everything in Saldova is built to load and work within seconds.

privacy.title: Privacy & security
privacy.desc: Your data is yours. Saldova is built fully GDPR-proof and stores everything heavily encrypted within the EU.

simple.title: Simplicity pays off
simple.desc: No superfluous features you never use. Only the tools you actually need to run your business.

about.philosophyTitle: Software adapts to you. Not the other way around.
about.philosophyBody1: Most accounting software forces you into an accountant’s logic: modules, codes and screens designed for number crunchers, not entrepreneurs. We flip that around. Saldova is built around how you work — creating an invoice, logging hours, recording a trip — in as few steps as possible.
about.philosophyBody2: Every feature has to earn its place. Anything you do not need, we leave out. What remains is a tool that is fast, clear and does exactly what you expect. That is how software should work: invisible in the background, while you run your business.
about.ctaSubtitle: No sales pitch — try Saldova yourself and see within a minute whether it fits.
about.backgroundLead: Saldova was not dreamed up at a drawing board. It grew out of practice.
about.backgroundP1: For years we built and optimised high-converting websites and digital platforms for freelancers and small businesses. From one-person companies to growing teams — we saw up close how entrepreneurs work online, where they get stuck, and what separates a website that merely looks good from one that actually brings in customers.
about.backgroundP2: In those collaborations the same problem kept coming back. Not the online presence itself, but what sits behind it: the admin. Entrepreneurs lost precious time and oversight to a patchwork of separate tools — one app for invoices, another for hours, yet another for VAT. Work that is not running a business, but comes back every week all the same.
about.backgroundP3: Saldova is the logical next step. The same eye we used to build websites that perform, we now apply to financial automation that just works: sleek, fast and designed from the entrepreneur’s daily reality. Digital presence and tight admin are not separate — they are both part of how you run your business.
about.backgroundP4: And that is what it comes down to. We understand how freelancers and small businesses work online, because for years we stood on their side of the screen. That experience is in every screen, every button and every choice in Saldova — software that does not make your day-to-day harder, but genuinely simpler.

s1.title: Your invoices at a glance
s1.body: These counters show at a glance how much has been paid and what amount is still outstanding. You know exactly which invoices need chasing.

s2.title: Create a new invoice
s2.body: This starts a new invoice. VAT and totals are calculated automatically, so your invoice is ready within a few minutes.

s3.title: Search and filter your invoices
s3.body: Search by customer or invoice number and filter by status or period. That way you can pull up, say, all outstanding invoices for this quarter in one go.

s4.title: Export for your accountant
s4.body: Download your filtered invoices as a CSV file. Handy for handing your accountant a tidy overview in a single click.

s1.title: All your quotes in one place
s1.body: Here you manage all your quotes, from first draft to accepted job. You will never lose track of what you offered a client.

s2.title: Create a new quote
s2.body: Put together a quote here with your own line items and prices. Your client receives a clean PDF and can respond right away, without endless email back and forth.

s3.title: Track every quote's status
s3.body: Once you have sent quotes, you see for each one whether it was accepted, declined or is still open. You know exactly which client could use a friendly follow-up call.

s1.title: A quote ready in one minute
s1.body: This is your fastest route to a quote: just a client name and a few lines. Ideal when you are with a client and want to give a price on the spot.

s2.title: Line items with automatic VAT
s2.body: Enter a description, quantity and price per line. Saldova instantly works out the subtotal, VAT and total for you, so there is nothing to calculate yourself.

s3.title: Generate a shareable link
s3.body: One click creates the quote and gives you a link you can text or email straight away. Your client views the quote online and can accept immediately.

s4.title: Your quick quotes, live
s4.body: Your latest quick quotes appear here with their status. The list refreshes itself, so you see it the moment a client accepts.

s1.title: Your expenses at a glance
s1.body: See right away what you've spent this year or quarter and how much VAT you can reclaim. That input VAT lowers your next VAT return.

s2.title: Add an expense
s2.body: Click here to record a business expense. Snap a photo of the receipt right away and your records are complete in one go.

s3.title: Filter by quarter
s3.body: View your expenses per quarter — exactly the period of your VAT return. In seconds you know which costs belong in which return.

s4.title: All your receipts in one place
s4.body: Every expense is listed here with its amount, VAT and receipt. If the tax office ever asks for proof, you open the receipt with one click.

s5.title: Receipts by email
s5.body: Send receipts from your phone to your own inbox address (see Settings). They show up here; Process opens the form with the photo and the scanner reads amount, date and VAT.

s1.title: Your money flow at a glance
s1.body: Instantly see what came in and went out, and how many payments are already linked to an invoice. You know where you stand without any math.

s2.title: Import your bank statement
s2.body: Download a CSV from your bank and drop it here. Saldova reads the transactions and automatically skips duplicates.

s3.title: Smart match suggestions
s3.body: Saldova recognises which incoming payments belong to which open invoice and lines them up here. One click to confirm and the invoice is marked as paid.

s4.title: All your transactions by month
s4.body: After an import your transactions appear here neatly grouped by month. Link payments to invoices or ignore private entries to keep things tidy.

s1.title: Your return, pre-filled
s1.body: These are exactly the amounts you enter with the tax office, box by box. Copy them over and you're done — no more manual math at filing time.

s2.title: Pick your filing period
s2.body: Switch quarters here. Handy when you want to check an earlier return or see how this quarter is shaping up.

s3.title: Pay or get money back
s3.body: This balance is the VAT you owe minus your input VAT. You know exactly how much to set aside for the tax office — no surprises at filing time.

s4.title: Export for your accountant
s4.body: Working with an accountant? Download all your figures for the year in one go. Saves emails and loose files going back and forth.

s1.title: Your hours at a glance
s1.body: See right away how many hours are still open and what they're worth. That way you know exactly what you can still invoice.

s2.title: Add hours or export
s2.body: With + New you log a work session in seconds. Ready for your bookkeeping? Export everything as CSV for your accountant.

s3.title: Let the timer do the clocking
s3.body: Start the timer when you begin working and stop it when you're done — the hours are filled in automatically. It even keeps running if you refresh the page.

s4.title: Compare your months side by side
s4.body: This chart shows your hours per month for the past six months, so you instantly see whether you're on track or a month is falling behind.

s5.title: Review your team’s hours
s5.body: Hours logged by employees land here first. Approve or reject them one by one (with a reason) or all at once. Only approved hours can be invoiced — the employee is notified automatically.

s1.title: Every kilometre counts
s1.body: Here you see your business and private kilometres and what you can deduct at €0.23 per kilometre. That way no tax benefit slips through.

s2.title: Add a trip or export
s2.body: With + New you record a trip: from, to and the distance. Tick round trip and the return leg is added automatically. You can also export everything as CSV here.

s3.title: Business and private kept separate
s3.body: Filter here between business and private trips. The tax office wants to see that split, and you see exactly which kilometres earn you money.

s4.title: Your kilometres per month
s4.body: This chart shows your business kilometres for the past six months — handy for spotting a month where you forgot to log trips.

s1.title: Your workload in numbers
s1.body: See how many tasks are open, in progress and past their deadline. Every morning you know exactly where to start.

s2.title: Create your first task
s2.body: Click here to create a task with a deadline, priority and optionally a project or customer. Everything you need to do lives in one place.

s3.title: Drag tasks to the right column
s3.body: This board works like a kanban: drag a card to in progress or done, or use the buttons on the card. Overdue tasks automatically float to the top.

s4.title: Find the right task fast
s4.body: Search by name, filter by priority, or switch between your own tasks and the whole team's. Handy once the board fills up.

s1.title: Estimate your tax reserve
s1.body: Choose the year and period, then enter revenue, business costs and actual deductible input VAT. The result estimates a reserve; it is not a tax assessment.

s2.title: Review your bank CSV
s2.body: Open a CSV and choose which incoming transactions represent revenue in the selected period. They are applied only after you confirm. Processing stays in your browser.

s3.title: Adjust your reserve
s3.body: For income tax, choose your own reserve percentage. The starting value is no guarantee of a sufficient reserve. A bv uses the annual corporate tax bands.

s4.title: Review your estimate
s4.body: This shows reserves, the extra margin and calculation steps. Remaining profit is not a bank balance. Review your assumptions and annual projection with your accountant.

s1.title: Your projects at a glance
s1.body: These counters show how many projects you have, which ones are active and how many clients you work for. You'll instantly know where your time is going.

s2.title: Start a new project
s2.body: Create a project here with a client and hourly rate. Hours and trips you log against it will automatically be ready for invoicing later on.

s3.title: Archive finished projects
s3.body: Done with a job? Archive the project: your list stays tidy while all hours and trips are kept. Tick this box to bring them back into view.

s4.title: Export for your records
s4.body: Download your project list as a CSV, including rates, hours and trips. Great for sharing with your accountant or keeping in your own records.

s1.title: Your customers in numbers
s1.body: See how many customers you have, who has already received invoices and what each relationship brings in. You'll know at a glance who your key customers are.

s2.title: Add a customer
s2.body: Set up a customer here with their address and VAT number. When you invoice, all details are filled in correctly right away — saving you lookups and mistakes.

s3.title: Find the right customer fast
s3.body: Type a name, email address or city and the list filters instantly. Even with dozens of customers you'll find the right one in seconds.

s4.title: Export your customer list
s4.body: Download your customers as a CSV, including revenue per customer. Useful for your accountant or for working with the data outside Saldova.

s1.title: Your team at a glance
s1.body: See how many seats you're using and what your team costs extra per month. That way you know exactly where you stand before adding someone.

s2.title: Invite your first team member
s2.body: One click creates an account for a colleague: name, email and password, done. As the owner you also decide right away whether someone becomes a manager.

s3.title: Who does what
s3.body: This overview shows booked hours, kilometers and invoices per team member. You can see who's working on what without having to ask around.

s1.title: Your leave balance at a glance
s1.body: These cards show your total budget, what you've already taken and what's still pending. You'll know exactly how many hours you have left before requesting anything.

s2.title: Request leave in a minute
s2.body: Pick the type, the period and the number of hours, then submit. As an employer you can also log your own days off here — they're approved instantly.

s3.title: All requests in one place
s3.body: Track the status of every request here: pending, approved or rejected. You can also withdraw an open request yourself.

s4.title: Budgets per employee
s4.body: As a manager you set each person's leave budget here — change the number and it's saved instantly. That way nobody slips into the red unnoticed.

s1.title: Your account's logbook
s1.body: Every important action in your administration is recorded here: who did what, and when. Useful when you work with a team and want to trace something back.

s2.title: Who, what and when
s2.body: Each row shows the time, the person and the action — with a color label per category, so invoices, leave or team changes stand out immediately.

s3.title: Find it in seconds
s3.body: Type a name or action into the search field at the top and the list filters instantly. In seconds you'll see who changed that one invoice.

s1.title: Your account at a glance
s1.body: Here you can see at a glance the name you work under, your account type and your current plan. That way you instantly know everything is set up right.

s2.title: Keep your details up to date
s2.body: Fill in your name, language and company details here. Your registration and VAT numbers will be correct everywhere — saving you hassle on every invoice.

s3.title: Manage your subscription here
s3.body: See your current plan, its status and when it renews. Upgrade or cancel yourself, right here — no emails or waiting required.

s4.title: Your data stays yours
s4.body: Download a full export of your data at any time. Great for your own records, and you always stay in control.

s5.title: Your receipt address
s5.body: This secret email address is yours alone. Save it as a contact on your phone and email receipts to it — they land in Expenses.

s1.title: Saldova as a Windows app
s1.body: This page is where you get Saldova as a real Windows app. Your admin in its own window, always within reach next to your other programs.

s2.title: Get the app right here
s2.body: This block shows your personal status: if you can download, the button is ready here. If not, you'll see exactly what's still needed.

s3.title: What you get
s3.body: The same familiar Saldova, but faster and in its own window. Your data stays secure and automatically in sync with the web version.

s4.title: Free on your phone, always
s4.body: Using Saldova on your phone costs nothing extra. The Windows app is a bonus — on the go you simply keep working for free.

recurring.removeConfirm: Delete the recurring invoice for {name}? Invoices already created are kept.

pwa.title: Add Saldova to your home screen
pwa.androidHint: Open Saldova as an app: its own icon, full screen, no browser bar. Free.
pwa.iosHint: Tap Share (the square with the arrow) and choose “Add to Home Screen”. Free, with its own icon.

assets.title: Assets & depreciation
assets.subtitle: Laptop, car, tools: enter the purchase once, Saldova depreciates monthly.
assets.intro: Business assets above €450 are depreciated over their useful life (fiscal maximum 20% per year, so at least 5 years). Depreciation automatically counts as costs in your reports.
assets.name: Description
assets.fiscalHint: Note: the Dutch tax authority allows at most 20% depreciation per year (at least 5 years), except in special cases.
assets.emptyHint: Add your laptop, car or tools — depreciation then runs automatically in your figures.
assets.disposeConfirm: Mark “{name}” as disposed/sold? Depreciation stops from today.
assets.removeConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its depreciation disappears from your reports.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Profit & loss, revenue per customer, costs per category and outstanding invoices — per year.
reports.noData: No data in this year yet.
reports.agingHint: Counted from the due date. The further right, the more important to follow up.

trialGate.title: Your trial has ended
trialGate.body: The 30 Business days for {company} are over. Choose a plan to keep working — all your data is ready and nothing is lost.
trialGate.paymentSoon: Online payment via iDEAL becomes available at the official launch. Contact us via the website and we'll activate your plan manually.
trialGate.dataSafe: Your administration, team and invoices are kept safe.

paymentReturn.title: Back from the payment page
paymentReturn.description: The payment provider is checking the payment. If it succeeded, the invoice will update automatically. You can close this window.
paymentReturn.help: Was the payment interrupted, or are you unsure? Check your bank statement or contact the invoice sender before paying again.
